admin.relays.activities.description: How many activities a relay brought in.

admin.relays.actor.description: Term in a relay's details: the actor of the relay, once it accepted the server.

admin.relays.back.description: Link from the page of one relay, or of the form that joins one, back to the list.

admin.relays.cancel.description: Button that closes the dialog of a relay without changing it.

admin.relays.change_failed.description: Error of leaving, joining again or deleting a relay. {reason} says why.

admin.relays.create_failed.description: Error of the form that registers a relay, for another reason than its URL. {reason} says why.

admin.relays.delete.description: Button that deletes the registration of a relay, and the confirming button of its dialog.

admin.relays.delete.description.defaultMessage: Son enregistrement est supprimé. Les publications déjà envoyées au relais continuent de recevoir leurs mises à jour et leurs suppressions. Cette action est irréversible.
admin.relays.delete.description.description: Description of the dialog that confirms deleting a relay.

admin.relays.delete.title.description: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting a relay. {name} is the host name of its URL.

admin.relays.delete_relay.description: Accessible name of the button that deletes a relay. {name} is the host name of its URL.

admin.relays.detail.title.description: Heading of the page of one relay.

admin.relays.domain_suspended.defaultMessage: Une mesure sur le domaine suspend le serveur de ce relais : rien ne lui est envoyé et rien n’en est reçu tant qu’elle s’applique.
admin.relays.domain_suspended.description: Warning on a relay whose host a domain action suspends.

admin.relays.domain_suspended.short.defaultMessage: Suspendu par une mesure sur le domaine
admin.relays.domain_suspended.short.description: Short warning in the list on a relay whose host a domain action suspends.

admin.relays.dropped.defaultMessage: Écarté au-delà de la limite, dernières 24 heures
admin.relays.dropped.description: Term in a relay's details: the activities it brought in during the last 24 hours that were dropped over the hourly limit.

admin.relays.empty.description: Heading of the empty list of relays.

admin.relays.empty.description.defaultMessage: Un relais transmet les publications publiques entre les serveurs qui le rejoignent, ce qui alimente le fil fédéré d’un petit serveur.
admin.relays.empty.description.description: Description of the empty list of relays.

admin.relays.follow.description: Button that asks to join again a relay that was left or rejected the server.

admin.relays.follow_relay.description: Accessible name of the button that joins a relay again. {name} is the host name of its URL.

admin.relays.followed.defaultMessage: Le serveur a demandé à rejoindre {name} à nouveau.
admin.relays.followed.description: Status after asking to join a relay again.

admin.relays.inbox.description: Term in a relay's details: the inbox the server sends to.

admin.relays.list.title.description: Heading of the list of the relays.

admin.relays.membership.joined.defaultMessage: Tant que le serveur est membre du relais ou demande à l’être, il lui envoie ses publications publiques. Quittez le relais pour arrêter ; un relais quitté peut être rejoint à nouveau ou supprimé.
admin.relays.membership.joined.description: Help of the membership of a relay that the server joined or asked to join.

admin.relays.membership.left.defaultMessage: Le serveur n’envoie rien à ce relais et n’en reçoit rien. Rejoignez-le à nouveau ou supprimez son enregistrement.
admin.relays.membership.left.description: Help of the membership of a relay that the server left or that rejected it.

admin.relays.membership.title.description: Heading of the section of a relay's page that leaves it, joins it again or deletes it.

admin.relays.new.description.defaultMessage: Les publications publiques de ce serveur vont à chaque relais qu’il rejoint, qui les transmet aux autres serveurs du relais. Les publications d’autres visibilités ne sont jamais envoyées.
admin.relays.new.description.description: Description of the form that registers and joins a relay.

admin.relays.new.title.description: Heading of the form that registers and joins a relay.

admin.relays.not_found.description: Heading of the page of a relay that the server does not have, such as a deleted one.

admin.relays.not_found.description.defaultMessage: Il a peut-être été supprimé. Les relais de ce serveur se trouvent sur l’écran des relais.
admin.relays.not_found.description.description: Description of the page of a relay that the server does not have.

admin.relays.problem.domain_suspended.defaultMessage: Le serveur du relais est suspendu par une mesure sur le domaine.
admin.relays.problem.domain_suspended.description: Why a relay was refused: a domain action suspends its host.

admin.relays.problem.exists.defaultMessage: Un relais avec cette URL est déjà enregistré.
admin.relays.problem.exists.description: Why a relay was refused: one with the same URL is registered.

admin.relays.problem.not_actor.defaultMessage: L’URL ne renvoie pas l’acteur d’un relais avec une boîte de réception.
admin.relays.problem.not_actor.description: Why a LitePub relay was refused: its URL serves no actor with an inbox.

admin.relays.problem.state.defaultMessage: Le relais n’est pas dans un état qui le permet : quittez un relais avant de le supprimer, et ne rejoignez à nouveau que celui qui a été quitté ou qui a rejeté le serveur.
admin.relays.problem.state.description: Why an operation on a relay was refused: its state does not allow it.

admin.relays.problem.url.defaultMessage: Saisissez une URL https d’au plus 2048 octets.
admin.relays.problem.url.description: Why a relay was refused: its URL is not an https URL of at most 2048 bytes.

admin.relays.protocol.description: Label of how a relay is joined (Mastodon or LitePub), and term of it in a relay's details.

admin.relays.protocol.auto.description: Choice of the protocol of a new relay: the server picks LitePub when the URL serves an actor, else Mastodon.

admin.relays.protocol.description.defaultMessage: La détection automatique choisit LitePub quand l’URL renvoie un acteur, et Mastodon sinon.
admin.relays.protocol.description.description: Help of the protocol of a new relay.

admin.relays.protocol.litepub.description: Protocol of a relay: joined at its actor, as Pleroma and Akkoma do.

admin.relays.protocol.mastodon.description: Protocol of a relay: joined at its inbox, as Mastodon and Misskey do.

admin.relays.receive.description: Checkbox of a new relay: whether to take in the public posts it relays.

admin.relays.receive.description.defaultMessage: Les publications publiques qu’il relaie apparaissent dans les fils fédéré et de hashtags, et sont conservées peu de temps. Sans cette option, le serveur ne fait qu’envoyer.
admin.relays.receive.description.description: Help of the checkbox that takes in the posts of a new relay.

admin.relays.receive.no.description: Value of whether a relay is received: the server only sends to it.

admin.relays.receive.term.description: Term in a relay's details: whether the server takes in the posts it relays.

admin.relays.receive.yes.description: Value of whether a relay is received: the server takes in the posts it relays.

admin.relays.relay.description: Column of the list of relays: the host name of the relay, linking to its page.

admin.relays.state.description: Term in a relay's details: where its membership stands.

admin.relays.state.accepted.description: State of a relay that accepted the server.

admin.relays.state.left.description: State of a relay that the server left.

admin.relays.state.pending.defaultMessage: En attente de la réponse du relais
admin.relays.state.pending.description: State of a relay that the server asked to join and that has not answered.

admin.relays.state.rejected.description: State of a relay that rejected the server or ended its membership.

admin.relays.state_changed_at.description: Column of the list of relays: when the relay's state last changed.

admin.relays.submit.description: Button that registers and joins a relay.

admin.relays.summary.defaultMessage: Rejoignez des relais de fédération pour échanger des publications publiques avec davantage de serveurs.
admin.relays.summary.description: Description of the relays screen in the administration menu of the settings.

admin.relays.taken.description: Term in a relay's details: the activities it brought in during the last 24 hours that were taken in.

admin.relays.title.description: Heading of the relays screen, and its link in the administration menu.

admin.relays.unfollow.description: Button that leaves a relay that the server joined or asked to join.

admin.relays.unfollow_relay.description: Accessible name of the button that leaves a relay. {name} is the host name of its URL.

admin.relays.url.description: Label of the URL of a new relay, its inbox or its actor, and term of it in a relay's details.

admin.relays.url.description.defaultMessage: La boîte de réception du relais pour Mastodon ou son acteur pour LitePub, une URL https.
admin.relays.url.description.description: Help of the URL of a new relay.
